description: Use when an agent needs a quick, cited fact sheet on a place, organization, thing or concept. Input: q (topic or title), optional lang (Wikipedia code, default en). Output: JSON title, description, extract, coordinates, thumbnail, page URL, Wikidata facts (instance of, inception, country, official website), CC BY-SA attribution. Best title match if not exact. Example: ?q=Seoul&lang=en Price: $0.005 USDC (Base or Solana) via x402.

lang.description: Wikipedia language code (default en; e.g. ko, ja, de, zh, simple)

name: knowledge_wiki
title: Wikipedia + Wikidata topic lookup: summary, coordinates, image, key facts, any language
